europe_now.title: Russia Deploys New Jet-Powered Drones Against Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Russia is increasingly using new jet-powered drones that are outpacing Ukraine's air defence systems. The daily attacks represent a significant escalation in aerial warfare.

sources.headline: Russia outpacing Ukraine's air defences with daily use of new jet-powered drones

europe_now.title: EU Allocates €115 Million for Ceuta Migration Crisis
europe_now.summary: The European Union has approved €115 million in emergency aid to Spain to manage the migration surge at the Ceuta border. The funding aims to address humanitarian needs and border security.

sources.headline: EU gives Spain 115 mn euros aid over Ceuta crisis

top_stories.title: European Space Strategy
top_stories.summary: The European Union is pursuing a €10 billion plan to challenge United States dominance in the satellite sector. The initiative aims to shift Europe from a passenger to a pilot role in space.

sources.headline: 'Passengers or pilots?' Europe looks to challenge US dominance in space sector with €10 billion plan

top_stories.title: EU Fiscal Policy Changes
top_stories.summary: New EU taxes are expected to reduce member states' financial contributions to the Brussels budget. European Council President Antonio Costa stated the changes will cut taxpayers' payouts.

sources.headline: New EU taxes will cut countries’ payouts to Brussels, Costa says

top_stories.title: EU Housing Regulation
top_stories.summary: The European Union is moving to restrict short-term rentals like Airbnb to alleviate housing shortages. The measure targets the impact of tourist accommodations on residential availability.

sources.headline: EU moves to curb Airbnb‑style rentals in bid to ease housing stress

top_stories.title: Record Global Temperatures
top_stories.summary: August has been declared the hottest month ever recorded globally. The milestone underscores accelerating climate change trends.

sources.headline: August declared the hottest month ever recorded
